simple: Removes standing local administrator rights on Windows, macOS and Linux computers and servers: approved programs and actions get elevated rights by policy, temporary administrator access is granted on request and recorded, and MFA can be required before elevation. Application control allows, blocks or ring-fences unknown programs (Restricted Mode) so they cannot act beyond what is allowed. Ready-made QuickStart policies protect against ransomware and against password theft from system memory, browsers and the Windows Credential Manager. For Linux — sudo policies and sign-in with directory accounts (Identity Bridge); there is also computer sign-in through the corporate identity provider (add-on) and integration with EDR and SIEM. A cloud service on the Idira platform; licensed per workstation or server.
